candidates.from: Great Basin Gas Transmission system, Storey County NV
candidates.to: Nexus Fulcrum 510 MW plant, former Fulcrum BioEnergy site, Tahoe Reno Industrial Center

evidence.note: Nexus Fulcrum LLC asked Nevada regulators on June 17 for a 510 MW gas plant at the Tahoe Reno Industrial Center to power additional data centers; behind-the-meter.
Says gas would come through a new lateral connecting to the Great Basin pipeline system; no length, route or diameter given; plant would serve one customer in the park.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Plant is tied to data center load by its application coverage and a new lateral is stated. Length unknown. May overlap the Tahoe Reno spur of existing row P7860 (Great Basin 2028 Expansion), so the consolidator should check before keeping it separate.

seed_ledger.name: Texas Eastern Line 31 Expansion Project (Line 31 Loop and Line 14-P Lateral)
seed_ledger.reason: NO_DC_TIE (real project, tie only indirect). Texas Eastern filed CP26-75 for a 10.2 mile 36-inch loop plus a 1.6 mile lateral to Entergy Mississippi's Traceview plant (750 MW, Ridgeland, Madison County), 125,000 Dth/d, loop sits about 11.8 mi total, Enbridge page now shows up to 160,000 Dth/d and in service late 2028. Not on the roster under any name. The state air permit response shows the plant sits next to an Amazon data center campus, but only through commenters. Entergy says it would need new plants even without Amazon, and no Entergy, Enbridge or FERC source says the plant or pipeline serves data centers. If the indirect tie is accepted under ruling 7 the row is: sponsor Texas Eastern (Enbridge), Madison County MS, proposed, about 11.8 mi, 36 and 16 in. Searches run: 5 this run (plus the earlier pass). Sources checked: Federal Register FERC notice 2026-02759 (project scope, plant named, no data center); pgjonline January 2026 (no data center); Mississippi DEQ response to comments, October 2026 (Amazon generators adjacent, comments only); News From The States on Amazon and Entergy bills (Entergy says plants needed anyway); Power Magazine and Entergy grid page (nothing on data centers found).

evidence.note: FERC notice of application: loop, lateral, Traceview plant, 125,000 Dth/d; no data center mention.
State response to comments: Amazon facility adjacent to plant site, raised by commenters.
Entergy says it would add plants in Ridgeland and Vicksburg without any growth.
